system.description:
You've nursed one of the legendary sewer alligators with your vitae for years, and careful breeding and vigilant training have produced a reptilian slave of exceptional intelligence — a mind as sharp as a five-year-old child's and teeth as keen as butcher knives. It understands your native language perfectly and can follow complex directions. Faster and deadlier than any human ghoul, it is a highly efficient killing machine capable of patrolling your domain with ruthless efficiency. It also loves to play "fetch" with human limbs, whether attached or severed.

Ghouled Reptile Buddy (V:tM stats): Physical: Strength 6, Dexterity 2, Stamina 6. Social: Charisma 0, Manipulation 0, Appearance 0. Mental: Perception 3, Intelligence 1, Wits 3. Disciplines: Fortitude 2, Potence 2. Blood Pool: 5. Willpower: 5. Attacks: Bite (7 dice), Tail Slap (6 dice).

MET Stats: Physical Traits (7), Social Traits (0), Mental Traits (2). Disciplines: Fortitude (Endurance, Mettle), Potence (Prowess, Might). Blood Pool 12. Willpower 3.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter One ("Legends and History"), "Merits and Flaws"
